name: 37278-mixedprompt-qwen3235bint8-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one whole a3 node (--gres=gpu:8).
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, expert parallelism off, one in-process vLLM engine; custom all-reduce disabled, so TP collectives go through NCCL; prefix caching off.
architecture: sparse-MoE decoder (Qwen3MoeForCausalLM), text only; 94 layers, 128 routed experts with 8 active per token, hidden 4096, 64 query heads / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128. ~236 GB over 48 shards, ~30 GB per GPU at TP=8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=140, bounded at 700 requests with an 1800 s safety cap; warmup 20% and cooldown 10% are declared; seed 37278 (the item number, so the synthetic corpus is reproducible per item).
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, prompt length uniform on [2800, 5200] tokens, generation length uniform on [1050, 1950] tokens and exact rather than EOS-terminated, no shared prefix.
purpose: A long-form analyst assistant drafting multi-page reports from lengthy briefs for 140 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
model: RedHatAI/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507-quantized.w8a8
tensor-parallel-size: 8
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 16384
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
enable-chunked-prefill: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
disable-custom-all-reduce: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.95
dtype: bfloat16
